sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: New "Pending edits" family in the 📊 unique-values dropdown, split into "Pending edits - Presence" (⏳ the binary `pending-edits-yes`/`pending-edits-no` flag pair) and "Pending edits - Entity" (✏️ the open `pendingedit:` per-value list, one entry per distinct entity, counted by ROWS). Both read MusicBrainz's OWN native `<span class="mp">` marker — the orange highlight it paints on an entity whose `/open_edits` list is non-empty — so no extra request is made. New `_findCellPendingEdits()` extractor, two `_cellMatchesStructureMode()` branches plus the `pendingedit:` compound one, and `_highlightPendingEditsMatch()`.

Unlike every other section family, these two are COLUMN-AGNOSTIC: the marker is a property of the entity, not of a column's grammar, so they are offered on every column of every page type with no `is…Col` gate — which is what the request asked for. That is also exactly why they are suppressed wholesale whenever nothing in the open column is pending (`pendingEditsYesCount > 0` at both emit sites): without that gate, every column on the whole site would grow a meaningless "○ no pending edits (N)" row. The upside is that the section appearing at all is itself the signal that a column has in-flight edits.

`_findCellPendingEdits()` reads each `span.mp` via `getCleanColumnText()`, not raw `textContent` — that helper already unwraps live `.mb-column-filter-highlight` spans, so re-running the extractor over its own previous output (a second filter pass, or reopening the dropdown while a pending-edits filter is still active) reports the same names instead of fragmenting or dropping them. It also reads straight through the extra nesting levels seen in real data: a `<span class="name-variation">` between the wrapper and the `<a>`, and a wrapper on only ONE artist of a joined credit.

Highlighting is scoped to the `span.mp` element itself, so on a "Queen & David Bowie" cell where only Bowie has open edits, checking his "» pending edit:" entry marks Bowie alone. `pending-edits-no` gets no highlighter — an absence has nothing to point at, same as `locale-not-primary`/`catalog-has-prefix`.

Gated by the new `sa_enable_pending_edits_section` setting (checkbox, default on). `_cellMatchesStructureMode()` re-checks it defensively on all three modes, so a pending-edits filter restored from a persisted/URL state saved while the setting was on cannot keep matching after it is turned off — same guard `lengthdeviation-*` already uses.

Both new counts and the per-entity value counts feed `panelBadgeChWidth`; "○ no pending edits" is normally the largest count in the whole panel, so omitting it there would have visibly clipped the badge column.

sections.label: 📝 Docs
items: `ShowAllEntityData_HELP.txt`: new "⏳/✏️ Pending edits" entry in the unique-values dropdown section list, documenting the column-agnostic behaviour, the hidden-unless-pending rule, the two highlighting modes, and the new setting.

New `tests/fixtures/uniq-drop-pending-edits.{html,spec.js}` (6 fixture tests): the section split and its row-counted values, the emit gate on a column with nothing pending, both highlighting modes, the re-open-after-filter pass that would catch a self-corrupting extractor, and the setting's off state including the defensive matcher guard. Four of the six fail against the previous revision.
